headline: Configure services and availability, share a secure booking page, and manage appointments and contac
summary: Bookings gives each Goalmatic account a focused owner workspace for services, weekly availability, secure public booking links, appointment management, and a contact history derived from bookings. Guest access is limited to release-pinned booking actions and never exposes the owner workspace.

benefits.title: Store booking profile
benefits.description: Creates an account-scoped Table for the public booking identity and link metadata.

benefits.title: Store availability
benefits.description: Creates an account-scoped Table for weekly schedules, timezone, notice, and booking horizon.

benefits.title: Store services
benefits.description: Creates an account-scoped Table for active public and private service definitions.

benefits.title: Store bookings
benefits.description: Creates an account-scoped Table for confirmed and cancelled appointments with unique slot reservations.

benefits.title: Receive public bookings
benefits.description: Allows an expiring booking link to read its public page, list openings, and create one conflict-safe booking.

howItWorks.title: Choose a workspace
howItWorks.description: Use your Goalmatic account and select where this App should work.

howItWorks.title: Review access
howItWorks.description: See the declared resources, permissions, and connected accounts before continuing.

howItWorks.title: Open the App
howItWorks.description: Start with the installed Store release in the workspace you selected.
